title: CLAUDE.md rule git-integration-branch-merge says a PR merges alone and may combine several reviewed lanes
why: The rule text says each lane PR merges alone, which the owner ruled is not exclusive; a lane reads it and refuses a combined PR that saves CI.
source: Owner 15:33 CST Nov 13 (item 767 a, ruling own-767-a-combined-pr), via the retrospective 15:34.
note: Filed 15:34 CST Nov 13. Wording only: "Each lane PR merges alone" becomes "A PR merges alone; it may combine several reviewed lanes", in the root CLAUDE.md rule git-integration-branch-merge and anywhere the same sentence sits (glossary, skill ci-hygiene step 8 for the child repos). Not the tool. A rule edit: a record-writer lane, reviewed (a rule's behaviour changes). Coordinator starts the lane.
